name: ProteinBench
description: ProteinBench is a holistic evaluation framework for protein foundation models, encompassing a taxonomic classification of protein tasks and a multi-metric evaluation approach assessing quality, novelty, diversity, and robustness. It includes an evaluation dataset, code, and a public leaderboard to promote transparency and standardized assessment.
typical_sota_score: varies by task; commonly reported in the ~60–95% range depending on the subtask
reputation: A recent framework with a public leaderboard that is gaining attention in protein foundation model evaluation, but it is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Includes taxonomic task classification and multi-dimensional evaluation; intended as a living benchmark with modular toolkit and public leaderboard.
